messages.subject: Halbrook / Meridian Quarter - facility
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

Credit have approved the £8,550,000 facility (60% LTV against the £14.25m purchase price), secured by a first legal charge over the property and a debenture over the SPV. Our solicitors will liaise with Whitfield Carter on the security pack and certificate of title. We'll need the report on title addressed to the bank, which I understand is in hand.

Gavin Doyle
Pennine Business Bank plc
